{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if '999999.99' appears in the revenue column
print("Looking for '999999.99' in revenue...")
print(df['revenue'].isin(['999999.99']).sum())

# Check all unique values again, but more explicitly
print("Unique revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Check for any revenue value that might be close to 999999.99 after parsing
# First, clean the revenue column by removing commas
revenue_clean = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any value close to 999999.99
print("Any revenue value close to 999999.99 (within 0.01)?")
print(revenue_clean[revenue_clean.between(999999.98, 999999.99, inclusive='both')])

# Check if there are any values above 999999.00
print("Any revenue > 999999.00?")
print(revenue_clean[revenue_clean > 999999.00])"}
